name: labs/asvela__keyoscacquire
title: Keysight InfiniiVision oscilloscope
intro: Keysight InfiniiVision oscilloscope, adapted from asvela/keyoscacquire. It reads `operation_condition`; sets `acq_type`, `num_averages`, `p_mode`, `num_points` and 1 more; runs `read_error`. `read_error`: read and remove the oldest entry of the instrument error queue (:SYSTem:ERRor?). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
